styleBible: Cinematic 2.5D anime visual-novel cutscene; contemporary Taipei workplace; restrained natural acting; clean line art with painterly light; fictional adult characters; stable anatomy; no readable text, logos, subtitles, watermarks, or camera shake.

characterBible.manager: Adult Taiwanese woman; shoulder-length straight black hair tucked behind one ear; slate-blue blazer, ivory top, charcoal trousers, black low heels; calm, attentive posture.
characterBible.employee: Young adult Taiwanese woman; chin-length chestnut-brown bob; mustard knit cardigan, ivory blouse, navy ankle trousers, white sneakers; initially guarded, gradually more confident.

items.prompt: Early morning in a glass meeting room. Slow steady dolly through a half-open door toward two glasses of water and two empty chairs. In the final two seconds, the manager and employee enter at opposite edges, sit down, and exchange a cautious professional nod. Warm sunlight crosses cool blue-gray walls; distant office ambience only. Keep both women consistent with the character bible. No dialogue.

Quiet private office while rain traces the window. Medium two-shot across a small table. The employee grips one cardigan cuff, pauses, slowly exhales, and looks up. The manager closes her notebook, places both hands open on the table, and listens without interrupting. Expressions shift subtly from guarded to cautiously relieved. Slow push-in, soft rainy window light, quiet rain and room tone only. Keep both women consistent with the character bible. No dialogue.

Cool morning light in the glass meeting room. Static medium-wide two-shot with more empty space between the characters. The manager sits upright and briefly gestures toward a closed notebook; the employee lowers her gaze, folds her hands close to herself, and becomes still. The camera slowly pulls back to make the room feel colder and more distant. Restrained uncomfortable silence, air-conditioning room tone only. Keep both women consistent with the character bible. No dialogue or aggressive gestures.

Early evening in a nearly empty Taipei open office. Over-the-shoulder view of the manager and employee arranging three blank sticky notes into a simple sequence on a desk. The employee points to the last note, considers it, then gives a small confident nod; the manager responds with an encouraging smile. Slow lateral camera move, warm desk lamp against cool city windows, subtle office ambience. Keep both women consistent with the character bible. No readable writing and no dialogue.

Taipei office rooftop garden just after rain at blue-gold dusk. The manager and employee walk side by side away from camera. The employee begins with slightly tense shoulders, then relaxes and gives a small confident nod; the manager answers with a warm restrained smile. Wet paving reflects skyline lights, leaves move in a light breeze, and the camera gently arcs to a calm three-quarter profile before settling on the glowing city. Soft wind and distant city ambience only. Keep both women consistent with the character bible. No dialogue.

Blue-hour open office after most coworkers have left. The manager and employee stand beside a desk with a blank weekly planner. The manager taps one empty square, the employee moves a small blank card into that square, and both nod with professional clarity. The mood is constructive but still slightly formal. Gentle push-in, practical desk lights and cool window reflections, quiet office ambience. Keep both women consistent with the character bible. No readable text and no dialogue.

Late morning in the glass meeting room after a difficult conversation. The employee gathers her notebook, pauses as if wanting to ask something, then chooses silence and leaves through the half-open door. The manager remains seated, notices the untouched second glass of water, and looks thoughtful. The camera holds a respectful distance and slowly pulls back. Cool desaturated light, subdued room tone. Keep both women consistent with the character bible. No dialogue or melodrama.
